## ⚠️ Pull requests are not accepted

Thanks for wanting to help! However, **this project does not accept pull requests**,
for **security reasons** — DeGhoster injects a DLL into other processes and configures
autostart, so every line that ships is written and reviewed by the maintainer alone to
keep the supply chain trustworthy. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

**Unsolicited PRs will be closed unmerged** — please don't spend effort here.

### Instead, please:

- 🐞 Report a bug: <https://github.com/motwok/DeGhoster/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml>
- 💡 Request a feature: <https://github.com/motwok/DeGhoster/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml>
- 🔒 Report a security issue **privately**: see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md)

You're of course free to **fork** under the [GNU AGPL v3](../LICENSE) — changes just
won't be merged back here.
